theorem lg_target (n : ℕ) : (n ^ 2 + n) % 2 = 0 := by
  cases n
  · -- case n = 0
    rw [Nat.add_zero, Nat.mod_zero]
  · -- case n = n' + 1
    obtain (h | h) : Even n ∨ Even (n + 1) :=
      by exact Or.inl (Nat.even_add_one n)
    · exact (Nat.even_iff.mp h).mpr (Nat.even_mul_even n n)
    · exact (Nat.even_iff.mp h).mpr (Nat.even_add_even n (Nat.even_iff.mp h))
